cards.subject: Change in Management
cards.body: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Appointment of Mr. Rohit Bansal as Chief Financial Officer.

bio.name: Mr. Rohit Bansal
bio.profile: Mr. Bansal is a chartered accountant. He was Chief Financial Officer at Syrma SGS Technology Limited (2021–2026) and earlier Deputy CFO at Amber Enterprises India Limited (2016–2021). He holds an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad.

cards.subject: Acquisition
cards.body: Deepak Nitrite Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of a specialty fluorochemicals business for an enterprise value of Rs. 1,150 crore.
